description.value: Sunfire Pizzeria is an artisanal pizza shop in Maple Ridge focused on quality ingredients, including locally sourced organic vegetables and premium meats. The menu spans classic and gourmet pies, baked and vegan wings, and gluten-free cauliflower crust options, with the ability to customize your own pizza. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through Maple Ridge on Dewdney Trunk Road.
